decisions.reason: As a newly launched sensor module that fits the firm's modular sensing platform and R&D-driven expansion, it is likely to stay unless demand proves clearly weak.
This industrial input module sits squarely in the firm's core automation offer and its dedicated product-page presentation suggests a stronger commercial commitment.
A solid state relay module complements the firm's established control and automation building blocks, so it is unlikely to be withdrawn so soon after launch.
The server room monitoring kit is somewhat more solution-specific than the core modules, but it still leverages the firm's existing platform and should remain on the market while the firm is growing.
